_comment: Spec examples this renderer does not reproduce, with the class each belongs to. Listed numbers are asserted to STILL fail: an example that starts passing is a test failure (remove it from the list), and an example that starts failing while it is not listed is a test failure too. Compliance can only go up. Refresh by copying the `actually failing: [...]` line `cargo test --lib spec -- --nocapture` prints, and only on purpose. The classes, largest first: (1) raw HTML the allow-list drops (SPEC §13) — most of both lists, including every example whose expected output contains an // element; (2) a leading `---` block, which this renderer reads as frontmatter and does not render (commonmark 96, 98); (3) pulldown-cmark nests same-type emphasis where cmark flattens it (`__foo, __bar__, baz__`; 12 GFM and 3 CommonMark examples); (4) the GFM autolink extension (`www.…`, bare emails) is not enabled in `markdown::render` (gfm 621-636).
